title: The letter
steps: You stand at the foot of a path before a great iron gate, at dusk. But let us go back: some weeks ago, a letter came.

It was an invitation to your first year at Arvelia, a school of magic, signed by the head of the school, Orla. It came with a picture of the school, an old castle on a hill above a deep lake, and your heart leaped when you read it.
Then came the journey: packing your bags, the long road, the village at the foot of the hill, and the steep climb at dusk that brought you here.
Now you stand before the gate. It is shut tight, with no handle and no bell, and you have no idea how to get in. But the old gate is very quiet, almost as if it were listening.
Before the story goes on, just one question: who are you?
